evidence.proof:
by
  intro r s h f
  constructor
  · intro hf
    rcases hf with ⟨a, ha⟩
    refine ⟨fun n => a (r n), ?_⟩
    exact (renaming_sound r a f).symm.trans ha
  · intro hf
    rcases hf with ⟨a, ha⟩
    refine ⟨fun n => a (s n), ?_⟩
    rw [renaming_sound]
    simpa only [h] using ha
